items.title: See agent list status beside the heading
items.detail: A spinner beside Agents shows when the list is refreshing, with cached agents still visible. If the list fails to load, tap the warning icon to see and copy the error.

items.title: Compatibility
items.detail: This build was not verified against Tightbeam 0.1.16 (build 4304), Tightbeam 0.1.15 (build 4082), or Chat v0.1.104. No version-specific test evidence is tied to this build.
